method: Parse every pinned sim/**/*.ts file with the pinned TypeScript parser and census every condition API call.

Keep semantic lifecycle/expiry paths as a reviewed layer above the exhaustive syntactic census.

copy transferable volatile state and clear source
bulk linked teardown and volatile removal on switch or faint
clear external-move lockedmove without End dispatch
